title: GitHub - [Retroactive] Actions workflow run logs delayed
text:
Service: GitHub
Incident: [Retroactive] Actions workflow run logs delayed
Status: resolved
Impact: minor
Started: 2026-10-14T00:12:44.500Z
Resolved: 2026-10-13T20:30:00.000Z
Updates:
- 2026-10-14T00:12:44.559Z: resolved - On October 13, around 20:42 UTC, an infrastructure failure caused GitHub Actions to have delays showing logs for workflow runs. No logs were lost and the issue has now been resolved and log processing has caught up.

The actual workflows producing the logs were not impacted and ran normally and no run delays or check delays occurred.

incident_updates.body:
On October 13, around 20:42 UTC, an infrastructure failure caused GitHub Actions to have delays showing logs for workflow runs. No logs were lost and the issue has now been resolved and log processing has caught up.

The actual workflows producing the logs were not impacted and ran normally and no run delays or check delays occurred.
